periods.time: vol-10 ch-005, night after the semifinals

name.zh: 天音住院后接受处分与约定
name.en: Amane accepts punishment and promises not to interfere

periods.location: Wangan Dome medical facility hospital room and corridor
periods.summary: Amane wakes in hospital and asks Nene whether Ikki is alive. Nene says Kiriko saved him and relays Kiriko's message that the first-round account has been repaid and Amane got what he deserved. Amane accepts that he would not even have beaten his first-round opponent and admits everyone is strong. Nene warns that the committee and League will likely impose severe punishment for his rampage, and Amane says he will accept it, asking her to speak for leniency. Nene agrees on the condition that he not interfere in Ikki and Stella's final, which he calmly promises. Outside, Nene confronts Tsukikage, questioning whether he meant for Ikki to save Amane and how he knew Amane's hidden past despite causality barriers; Tsukikage defers the answer.
periods.cause: Amane's defeat, rampage, and Ikki's survival force a reassessment of his self-abandonment and future conduct.
periods.outcome: Amane no longer intends to contaminate the final and will face institutional discipline; Tsukikage's hidden ability/motive becomes an explicit mystery.
periods.significance: Closes Amane's vol-10 arc by moving him from self-erasure toward accountable challenge, while preserving Tsukikage's larger plot thread.
